class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;self.n=25
  self.feet=[self.d.site_xpos[i].copy() for i in [1,2]]

  self.M=np.zeros((self.m.nv,self.m.nv));self.kp=self.m.actuator_gainprm[:,0];self.kd=-self.m.actuator_biasprm[:,2]
 def jac(self,site):
  jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy();mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,self.d,jp,jr,site);return np.vstack([jp[:,:25],jr[:,:25]])
 def action(self,feet=None,base=None,hands=None,contacts=(True,True)):
  d=self.d;m=self.m;n=25;v=d.qvel[:n]
  if feet is None:feet=self.feet
  if base is None:base=self.base
  A=[];b=[];Js=[]
  def task(J,acc,w):A.append(w*J);b.append(w*acc)
  for k,site in enumerate([1,2]):
   J=self.jac(site);Js.append(J)
   R=d.xmat[[6,11][k]].reshape(3,3)
   err=Rotation.from_matrix(R.T).as_rotvec();err=R@err
   acc=np.r_[180*(feet[k]-d.site_xpos[site])-26*(J[:3]@v),120*err-22*(J[3:]@v)]
   task(J,acc,3 if contacts[k] else 1)
  J=np.eye(n)[:6];R=d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3);Rt=Rotation.from_euler('z',self.yaw).as_matrix();err=R@Rotation.from_matrix(R.T@Rt).as_rotvec()
  task(J,np.r_[60*(base-d.qpos[:3])-16*v[:3],100*err-20*v[3:6]],1)
  task(np.eye(n)[6:],40*(self.pose-d.qpos[7:26])-10*v[6:],.15)
  if hands:
   for site,target in hands.items():
    J=self.jac(site)[:3];task(J,100*(target-d.site_xpos[site])-20*(J@v),1.5)
  A=np.vstack(A);b=np.concatenate(b)
  qdd=np.linalg.solve(A.T@A+.0001*np.eye(n),A.T@b)
  mujoco.mj_fullM(m,self.M,d.qM)
  req=self.M[:n,:n]@qdd+d.qfrc_bias[:n]-d.qfrc_passive[:n]
  Jc=np.vstack([Js[k] for k in range(2) if contacts[k]])
  # solve floating base force balance; regularise foot moments
  scale=np.tile([1,1,1,.15,.08,.08],len(Jc)//6)
  B=Jc[:,:6].T*scale
  f=scale*(B.T@np.linalg.solve(B@B.T+1e-7*np.eye(6),req[:6]))
  tau=req[6:]-Jc[:,6:].T@f
  tau=np.clip(tau,m.actuator_forcerange[:,0],m.actuator_forcerange[:,1])
  qtar=d.qpos[7:26]+(tau+self.kd*v[6:])/self.kp
  return np.clip(2*(qtar-m.actuator_ctrlrange[:,0])/np.ptp(m.actuator_ctrlrange,axis=1)-1,-1,1)
